title: CliResult
description: The one JSON document every CLI command prints on standard output. Built by src/cli/result.ts; Claude parses it and tests assert on it.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

command.description: Name of the command that ran, for example "doctor"; empty when no command was given.

ok.description: True when the command succeeded and exitCode is 0.

data.description: Command-specific payload: any JSON value, null when the command failed. Each command documents its shape.

artifacts.description: Absolute paths of the files the command produced for the user, in the order they were written.

errors.description: The errors that stopped the command; empty when ok is true.

evidence.description: Absolute paths of the evidence files (reports, contact sheets) the command wrote.

ExitCode.description: Process exit code: 0 success, 1 failure, 2 usage error, 130 cancelled.

CliResultError.description: One error entry: a stable code, what went wrong and what to do next.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, for example "usage" or "tool-missing".

message.description: What went wrong, one sentence for a person.

hint.description: What to do next, one sentence for a person.
